scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd packages/shm-native typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/retina-local-fs typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/retina-local-fs build && bun run --cwd packages/opencode-plugin typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd packages/retina-local-fs lint && bun run --cwd packages/opencode-plugin lint
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/shm-native test && bun run --cwd packages/retina-local-fs test && bun run --cwd packages/opencode-plugin test
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/shm-native build:js && bun run --cwd packages/retina-local-fs build && bun run --cwd packages/opencode-plugin build
scripts.check:repo: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- packages/opencode-plugin/src/tui-compiled && ! git ls-files --others -- packages/opencode-plugin/src/tui-compiled | grep .
